44566.title: Line actions offered match the line's status

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Work Order Lines: Create & Edit, in Full View).

2. Open a work order with lines in each status, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab. Reach the statuses this way: a brand-new line via "New Line" is Needs Approval; approve it to make it Approved; decline it (from the line's three-dot (more_vert) menu at the right of the line row) to make it Declined; complete an Approved line (its "Complete" button) to make it Complete.

2. Open a work order with lines in each status, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab. Reach the statuses this way: a brand-new line via "New Line" is Needs Approval; approve it to make it Approved; decline it (from the line's three-dot (more_vert) menu at the right of the line row) to make it Declined; complete an Approved line (its "Complete" button) to make it Complete.

blocks: 1. Open the ... menu (and check the bulk bar) for a Needs Approval line.
2. Repeat for Approved, Declined and Complete lines.
custom_steps.text:
1. Open the ... menu (and check the bulk bar) for a Needs Approval line.
2. Repeat for Approved, Declined and Complete lines.

blocks: 1. Needs Approval: Approve, Decline, Request part, Delete line.
2. Approved: Decline, Authorization required, Complete, Request part, Delete line.
3. Declined: Approve, Authorization required, Request part, Delete line.
4. Complete: Decline, Authorization required, Uncomplete.
5. Any action not listed for a status is not visible, on the line or in the bulk action bar.
6. Complete is not offered on a Needs Approval line and Approve is not offered on an already-Approved line (both do nothing).

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9252 (Story 6, Which actions appear on a line and on a part) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

44568.title: Part actions offered match the part's state (seven states)

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Work Order Lines: Create & Edit + Full View, Pick Parts and Order Parts).

2. Open a work order, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, with parts in each state on its lines: Requested, Quoted, Auth to order, In Stock (unpicked), Awaiting, Received later, and Received/picked (and a Returned part). A part's state shows as its status badge on its row; states are reached through the part lifecycle (add a part request, Order it, Receive it, Pick it, return it).

2. Open a work order, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, with parts in each state on its lines: Requested, Quoted, Auth to order, In Stock (unpicked), Awaiting, Received later, and Received/picked (and a Returned part). A part's state shows as its status badge on its row; states are reached through the part lifecycle (add a part request, Order it, Receive it, Pick it, return it).

blocks: 1. For a part in each state, look at the actions on its row.

blocks: 1. Requested: nothing on the row (no price yet), but still counted in the bulk bar's Order (n).
2. Quoted: Order. Auth to order: Order.
3. In Stock and not picked: Pick.
4. Awaiting: Receive, with Received later behind its caret when receiving is required.
5. Received later: nothing on the row, Receive in the ... menu.
6. Received or picked: nothing (finished). Returned: nothing (sent back, stays visible on the line and in returns).

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9252 (Story 6, Which actions appear on a line and on a part) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

44569.title: Ordering precedes receiving; Receive placement follows the setting

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Order Parts permission).

2. Open, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, a work order with a vendor-sourced part that is unordered; you can toggle the receiving setting in Settings -> the "Work Orders" tab (Require Receiving Parts Before Completion).
custom_preconds.text:
1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Order Parts permission).
2. Open, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, a work order with a vendor-sourced part that is unordered; you can toggle the receiving setting in Settings -> the "Work Orders" tab (Require Receiving Parts Before Completion).

blocks: 1. With ordering required, check whether Receive appears before the part is ordered.
2. With receiving not required, check where Receive appears for a part.
custom_steps.text:
1. With ordering required, check whether Receive appears before the part is ordered.
2. With receiving not required, check where Receive appears for a part.

blocks: 1. With ordering required, Receive does not appear until the part has been ordered; Order and Receive are never offered at once for the same part.
2. With receiving not required, Receive moves from the part row into the part's ... menu - it is never removed outright.

3. Ordering a Requested part only does something when the part is vendor-sourced (including a vendorless part marked Vendor missing); an inventory/found part or one with no source needs its details completed first.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9252 (Story 6, Which actions appear on a line and on a part) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

44570.title: Declining or sending back a line returns only not-yet-arrived parts to Quoted

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Work Order Lines: Create & Edit, in Full View).

2. Open, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, an Approved line holding parts in mixed states: Requested, In Stock, Quoted, Auth to order, Awaiting, Received and Returned (states shown as each part's status badge).
custom_preconds.text:
1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (Work Order Lines: Create & Edit, in Full View).
2. Open, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, an Approved line holding parts in mixed states: Requested, In Stock, Quoted, Auth to order, Awaiting, Received and Returned (states shown as each part's status badge).

blocks: 1. Decline the line (or send it back with Authorization required).
2. Check the state of each part afterwards.
custom_steps.text:
1. Decline the line (or send it back with Authorization required).
2. Check the state of each part afterwards.

blocks: 1. Only In Stock, Quoted, Auth to order and Awaiting parts are moved back to Quoted.
2. A Requested part is left where it is, and so are Received and Returned parts.
3. Parts that were received or picked are not touched by a line status change, and no stock moves because of one.
4. Declining a line does not remove its parts from a purchase order (only deleting a part does that).
5. A part action the user's role does not carry is absent even when the part's state qualifies (Pick follows Pick Parts, Order follows Order Parts).

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9252 (Story 6, Which actions appear on a line and on a part) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.
